verdict.rationale: Account sign-in with free-tier access is a fair question for a coding assistant, but the evidence pack never documents Aider offering account login or a bundled free tier. The closest items are local models via Ollama and copy/pasting to an LLM web chat. Both are adjacent workarounds, not sign-in-based free access, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As a developer, I can sign in with a personal account to get free-tier access without managing API keys
